review_highlights.sentence: "Get some pampering and upkeep, and finish the evening off shopping."
"A few weeks after my first session I received compliments on my skin texture."
"I’m a picky B and she gave me BIG Russian lips just like I wanted."

reviews.text: WOW!! Kristin is an artist with all injections!! - I think some of her story is she spent the better part of 15 years training under one of Beverly Hills BEST plastic surgeons & IT SHOWS. She is incredibly skilled. I found her on social media (@medaestheticspa on IG) because of some of the work she had done & I’ve been with her ever since. She’s great at not *overtoxing and exceptional at knowing what questions to ask to help achieve the looks you’re going for if you’re doing other injections.  - 10/10 would recommend!

I had the most amazing facial with Saylor! She was so kind, professional, and knowledgeable. She took the time to explain everything she was doing and made sure I was completely comfortable the whole time. My skin feels refreshed, glowing, and healthier than ever. You can tell she truly cares about her clients and loves what she does. I can’t wait to book my next appointment with her—highly recommend Saylor if you’re looking for the best facial experience!

I recently had a facial with Saylor and she exceeded my expectations. She took the time to go over my skin concerns and recommend products without being pushy. Most relaxing and thorough facial I've ever had! I also see Jamie Lynn for Botox and will never let anyone else touch my face. Both are phenomenal!

I had the most amazing experience with Saylor! From the moment I walked in, she made me feel completely comfortable and cared for. I booked the Signature Facial, and WOW — my skin has never looked or felt better. She was so knowledgeable, gentle, and attentive to my skin’s needs. When we finished, I left with the most beautiful glow and so much confidence. If you’re looking for an aesthetician who truly knows how to pamper you while delivering real results, I can’t recommend Saylor enough! And don’t forget about all of the amazing Skin Better products!

I followed Kristin Polega - who is hands down one of the BEST injectable providers in Nashville - to SkinSpirit as she embarked on another chapter in her career. Today was my first appointment at her new location and it is absolutely beautiful inside - with each individual room being super spacious! I personally trust Kristin with my life, or shall I say ‘face’ when it comes to my botox and filler appts, because she’s always really kind & super thorough in her chats/assessments with me - nailing the work every single time! I’ve never had to go back for one revision….so if you don’t have a dedicated individual right now, she’s definitely worth the try because her work is magical! Thank me later!!!

Courtney, at the front desk, was extremely warm and welcoming at my arrival and she also gave me some additional background on the company’s history. I didn’t realize SkinSpirit was the leading provider for Botox and fillers in the U.S., with over 41 current locations spanning from California to NY. So if you move or travel, they can access your records at any location. There’s no starting over. [Not to mention, their original flagship location started in Silicon Valley 20 years ago!]

Last but not least, this office is conveniently located in Brentwood, off the same large parking lot as Nordstroms Rack. How is that not an incentive ladies?! Go! Get some pampering and upkeep, and finish the evening off shopping. You’re welcome. 😇

I’ve been using Saylor Smith for the last three years and wouldn’t use anyone else! She’s extremely knowledgeable regarding skincare as well as each of the services they offer, and she always thoroughly explains the pros and cons of each. if you’re looking for someone knowledgeable and dependable call Saylor, and you will definitely see amazing results each and every time!

I just want to come here and say that Kristin my injector was absolutely fantastic and quick and personable. Also front Desk team was one of the kindest and sweetest person at a Medspa that I’ve ever met in my life. I highly recommend coming here. I am now a loyal client. Jamie

This place has it all! I saw Saylor for a chemical peel and she is SO knowledgeable, put me right at ease - PLUS, she’s darling and just so easy to chat with! I’ll definitely be seeing her again for a custom facial!!

attributes.AboutThisBizBio: Emily is a Family Nurse Practitioner who has worked in the healthcare field for more than eight years. She joined Med Spa Franklin after specializing in aesthetic injectables for the last two years at one of the top med spas in St. Louis. She attended Southeast Missouri State University in Cape Girardeau, MO for both her Bachelor's and Master's degrees. Emily specialized in Orthopedic Surgery before advancing her career as a Nurse Practitioner. While attending school full-time, she not only worked as an Orthopedic nurse, but also as a makeup artist. Emily understands the importance of looking and feeling your best. While makeup can make you feel great, it is very temporary. Being an aesthetic nurse allows Emily to provide that "Wow" effect for her clients that lasts so much longer than makeup. She is committed to listening to her patients in order to address their aesthetic concerns. Her ultimate goal is ensuring her patients are more than thrilled with their outcomes.
attributes.AboutThisBizSpecialties:
Med Spa Franklin is your go-to for all beauty and aesthetic treatments in the greater Nashville area. We specializing in treatments laser hair removal, laser skin tightening, Viveve therapy, dermal fillers, Botox and Dysport. We have now incorporated not only elite laser technology for all skin types, but also offer an array of modern aesthetics that will enhance your experience and your natural glow. Consultations are always complimentary.
We are also an authorized dealer for all SkinMedica products!

attributes.about_this_biz_history: The Franklin Center for Skin & Laser Surgery near Nashville is a physician-run medical practice that specializes in cosmetic dermatology and aesthetic surgery. Our physician, Steven Bengelsdorf, M.D., F.A.C.S., is a board certified surgeon with over 15 years experience. He is a Fellow of both the American College of Surgeons and the American Society for Laser Medicine and Surgery. He possesses both the technical and artistic skills required to achieve high quality, natural-looking results. Our registered nurses and licensed clinical aestheticians are each personally trained and supervised by our physician. Each member of our staff takes your aesthetic and skin care needs seriously and can help create a program that is right for you.

reviews.text: I had the Diamond Glow facial and collagen mask with Lindsey Carver. She was very helpful to me, as facials are not something in my normal life! She was professional, kind, knowledgeable, and seemed to understand times that I wanted to talk, and times I wanted to relax. The staff member that welcomed me in to Elan skin was also super sweet. I think his name was Jeff. The lobby was welcoming and beautifully decorated. I was honored to spend an hour there!

I just finished my 6 sessions of laser hair removal (Brazilian), and I have nothing but good things to say about ELAN Skin, but especially about my esthetician, HELEN.

Helen is absolutely wonderful at what she does, but not only that— she also just made me feel so comfortable and confident while I was in her care. I would now consider her more like a friend. I highly recommend booking your skin needs here, specifically with Helen. She is an absolute doll.
Erica was amazing! I went in for a signature facial! I got more than i bargain for! If  your looking for a good facial stop looking and book!!!

Elan Skin and Jen Ragan are my go-to for all my skincare needs. Jen is simply fantastic! She is extremely knowledgeable in all the products and procedures that work best for all skin types and how to keep your face well maintained and glowing. I have been a client of Jen's for years, but you wouldn't know it - which is a great testament to Jen.

Going to Elan is the best 15-20 minutes of my month sometimes when I just need a quick pick me up. Whenever my eyebrows are in shambles, I trust Jenny to make me look human again, and I'm so grateful for Jim at the front desk who is always so warm and inviting.

I’ve been a loyal and faithful Elan customer for 3 years. It’s my husbands go to for gift cards to spoil me. Love love love Jen Ragan. Anne came highly recommended and did not disappoint. The entire team is knowledgeable and so helpful and honest about doing what’s right for your skin.Great job Shayna and Derek! You’ve got a lifetime customer.

I moved from out of state to TN and needed to find a new place where I could get my regular beauty treatments.  I really love Elan Skin and the team.  I’ve had tons of experience in receiving skin care treatments and I can say that they are NOT all the same.  The team here is professional and always welcoming.  The environment is clean and has a stylish vibe.  Lindsay does a great job taking care of my skin and she is also fun to talk with during my sessions.

I just wanted to jump on here and give some appreciation for the entire staff at Elan. I always get wonderful skin services from Jen and Ann- that’s just a given. Best in the biz. But the front desk and management staff here also goes above and beyond. There was an issue with one of my Alle coupons today (website related, not their fault at all) and Jim reached out today to get it taken care of for me immediately. With today being 12/23 and the holiday madness going on, they still went way above my expectations for great service. The whole staff makes sure you have a good experience and leave happy.

reviews.text:
Anna is the absolute best. She really took her time during my facial and gave me so many great suggestions to help with my hormonal acne. I loved how she was able to do a facial but could also chat with me about the medical procedures available to help with scaring etc.
I will absolutely be back. Her office was clean, cozy and relaxing.

Anna, at the Franklin location is the absolute BEST, not only is she talented and knowledgeable, but answers all of my questions with kindness and patience. She has created such a warm and inviting space, I just love it! I met Anna at an initial consultation over a year ago and she thoughtfully addressed all of my concerns, and I felt so comfortable with her recommendations. I can’t imagine trusting my aesthetic needs to anyone else!
I look forward to seeing Anna for my treatments. She is warm, friendly and takes care in her work. Can’t say enough about the wonderful experience she provides.
Anna is the best! She takes time to address my main skin concerns each time. She always makes sure I am comfortable and explains everything very thoroughly before doing it.

Anna is the BEST. She is super friendly and is super helpful assessing skin needs. I would highly recomend Anna to anyone looking to improve the look and feel of their skin. Anna is also a highly skilled injector - I know firsthand.

I mentioned in my original review from my first experience with Anna, that I would return - and I definitely just that. I left more than satisfied after traveling from Atlanta to see her specifically. The care and precision She puts into her treatments, compares to no one and she is worth the 4 hour drive every time.
I am already looking forward to making my next appointment.

"I can't say enough about Anna.  She performed dermaplaning and a facial on me today.  She did a wonderful job making me feel comfortable and relaxed during the treatments.  She is very professional and I would highly recommend using her.  It's obvious she is knowledgeable about skin care which is important. She explained what she would be doing every step of the way. She is a "pro" and I will continue to go to her for future treatments.
Anna is terrific! She is very knowledgeable and always makes me feel so comfortable. I highly recommend Smiley Asthetics .
